name: Divine Burden
body:
School conjuration [force]; Level druid 6, sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area 30-ft.-radius burst
Duration 1 minute/level
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell targets all divine spellcasters within range. All those affected must succeed on a Fortitude save or be treated as if heavily encumbered.
